title.en: Honda scooters switch off their engine at every red light 🤯 #shorts
title.id: Skutik Honda matiin mesinnya sendiri di lampu merah 🤯 #shorts

description.en: Honda's Idling Stop System shuts the engine off after three seconds at a stop and restarts it the moment you open the throttle. The trick: the ACG starter, a generator on the crankshaft that also works as the starter motor, with no gears.
description.id: Idling Stop System Honda mematikan mesin setelah tiga detik berhenti dan menyalakannya lagi begitu gas diputar. Kuncinya ACG starter: generator di poros engkol yang sekaligus jadi motor starter, tanpa gigi.

scenes.en: Honda scooters switch their own engine off at *every red light*.
scenes.id: Skutik Honda bisa matiin mesinnya sendiri di *setiap lampu merah*.

scenes.en: Stop for *three seconds* with the throttle closed, and the engine just quits. No fuel burned, no noise.
scenes.id: Berhenti *tiga detik* dengan gas tertutup, mesinnya langsung mati. Nggak ada bensin terbuang, nggak berisik.

scenes.en: Twist the throttle and it's running again before you move. The secret is one part doing *two jobs*.
scenes.id: Begitu gas kamu putar, mesin sudah hidup lagi sebelum motor jalan. Rahasianya satu komponen dengan *dua tugas*.

scenes.en: On the end of the crankshaft sits a ring of magnets around copper coils. That's the *generator* that charges your battery.
scenes.id: Di ujung poros engkol ada cincin magnet yang mengelilingi kumparan tembaga. Itu *generator* yang ngecas aki kamu.

scenes.en: Honda's *ACG starter* sends battery power the other way, so the generator becomes a motor and spins the crankshaft itself.
scenes.id: *ACG starter* Honda mengalirkan listrik aki ke arah sebaliknya, jadi generatornya berubah jadi motor dan memutar poros engkol sendiri.

scenes.en: No starter gears means *no grinding*. The restart is almost silent, so it can happen at every single light.
scenes.id: Tanpa gigi starter, *nggak ada suara kasar*. Hidupnya hampir tanpa suara, jadi bisa terjadi di setiap lampu merah.

scenes.en: So, would you trust your scooter to restart *every single time*?
scenes.id: Jadi, kamu percaya nggak motormu bakal nyala lagi *setiap kali*?
